courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 天文自適應光學
related.transfer: 可遷移「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」與「光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；天文自適應光學的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section" and "Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Astronomical adaptive optics must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦鈉層共振散射、錐效應與傾斜不確定性、589 nm 雷射源、回波光子預算、光點拉長、對焦追蹤與多雷射整合；天文自適應光學則以從 Fried 參數到 Strehl 預算的 VLT／ELT 自適應光學工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sodium resonance scattering, cone effect and tilt indeterminacy, 589 nm sources, return-photon budgets, spot elongation, focus tracking and multi-laser integration; Astronomical adaptive optics centres on VLT and ELT adaptive-optics engineering from the Fried parameter to the Strehl budget, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「中氣層鈉原子層」與「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到天文自適應光學，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「誤差預算與 Strehl 比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Mesospheric sodium layer” and “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Astronomical adaptive optics, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget and the Strehl ratio", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sodium resonance scattering, cone effect and tilt indeterminacy, 589 nm sources, return-photon budgets, spot elongation, focus tracking and multi-laser integration; Segmented-mirror co-phasing control centres on optical cost of segment piston, edge sensors and actuators, 2π ambiguity, phasing cameras, set-point calibration and segment exchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Mesospheric sodium layer” and “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文雷射導引星
history.text: 1982 年 William Happer 提出利用中氣層鈉原子做人造導引星，1985 年 Foy 與 Labeyrie 在天文文獻中公開發表此概念；1990 年代中期 Lawrence Livermore 國家實驗室在 Lick 天文台 3 m Shane 望遠鏡上首次以鈉雷射導引星明顯改善天文影像。2004 年 Keck II 開始提供鈉雷射導引星自適應光學，ESO 於 2016 年 4 月在 VLT UT4 啟用以拉曼光纖雷射為基礎的四雷射導引星設施 4LGSF，極大望遠鏡則規劃以多道雷射進行斷層自適應光學。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及雷射操作程序。
history.textEn: In 1982 William Happer proposed using mesospheric sodium as an artificial guide star, and in 1985 Foy and Labeyrie published the concept in the astronomical literature; in the mid-1990s Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory first achieved clear image improvement with a sodium laser guide star on the 3 m Shane telescope at Lick Observatory. Keck II began offering sodium laser-guide-star adaptive optics in 2004, ESO commissioned the Raman-fibre-laser-based Four Laser Guide Star Facility on VLT UT4 in April 2016, and extremely large telescopes plan multi-laser tomographic adaptive optics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic, not laser operating procedures.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」到「運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section" through "Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
